ko.title: 의회, 광범위 러시아·이란 제재 법안을 트럼프에게 상정

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: 하원이 러시아와 이란을 겨냥한 광범위한 제재 패키지에 최종 승인을 내렸으며, 이 조치는 트럼프 대통령의 서명을 위해 송부되었다.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 상원이 먼저 자신의 버전을 승인한 후 양 정당의 지지로 하원을 통과했으며, 미국이 모스크바와 테헤란에 대한 경제적 압박을 어디까지 강화해야 하는지에 관한 수개월간의 협상을 종료했다.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## 법안이 목표로 하는 것

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: 의회 직원들이 공개한 요약에 따르면, 이 법안은 세 가지 주요 영역에 중점을 둔다:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **러시아의 에너지 부문** — 러시아 석유 및 천연가스 수출을 촉진하는 회사 및 금융 기관에 대한 새로운 제약.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"암흑 함대"** — 분석가들이 러시아가 기존 가격 상한선과 수출 제한을 우회하여 석유를 이동하는 데 사용해온 노후하고 불투명하게 소유된 유조선 네트워크에 대한 제재.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **이란 관련 네트워크** — 이란의 에너지 수출 및 관련 금융 거래를 지원한 혐의를 받는 주체들을 겨냥한 추가 조치.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: 법안을 지지한 의원들은 이를 두 국가가 수년간의 이전 제재에도 불구하고 상당한 양의 석유를 전 지구적 시장으로 계속 흘려보낼 수 있게 해준 허점을 막기 위한 노력이라고 설명했다.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## 백악관을 위한 새로운 관세 도구

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: 가장 주목받는 조항 중 하나는 대통령에게 러시아 석유를 상당한 양으로 계속 구매하는 국가들로부터의 상품에 최대 100%의 관세를 부과할 수 있는 재량권을 부여한다.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이 도구가 러시아를 직접 압박하기보다는 구매자들에게 계속된 구매의 경제적 비용을 훨씬 더 높게 만들어 러시아산 석유에서 다양화하도록 압박하기 위해 고안되었다고 말한다.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: 무역 분석가들은 이러한 관세가 광범위하게 사용될 경우 전 지구적 공급망과 국내 필요를 위해 러시아 에너지를 수입하는 국가들과의 관계에 파급 효과를 미칠 수 있다고 경고했다.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: 법안은 보도에 따르면 자동 조치를 요구하기보다는 언제 그리고 누구에게 이 권한을 적용할지 결정하는 데 백악관에 상당한 유연성을 남긴다.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## 캐피톨 힐의 반응

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: 이 조치는 정치적 스펙트럼 전반에 걸친 의원들의 지지를 얻었으며, 양 정당의 지지자들은 이를 우크라이나 전쟁과 이란의 지역 활동에 대한 오래 지연된 대응으로 표현했다.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: 일부 의원들은 에너지 가격과 할인된 러시아산 석유에 의존해온 동맹국 경제에 미칠 수 있는 잠재적 영향에 대해 본회의 토론 중 우려를 제기했으나, 이러한 우려는 통과를 막기에 충분하지 않았다.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 의회 지도부는 이 법안이 기존 제재가 모스크바와 테헤란으로 흐르는 수익을 충분히 억제하지 못했다는 양당 합의를 반영한다고 밝혔다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은 무엇인가

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: 양 의원이 자신의 버전을 통과시킨 후, 법안은 이제 트럼프 대통령에게 제출되며, 그는 이를 법으로 서명할지 말지를 결정하기 전에 검토할 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: 행정부 관계자들은 법안이 제정될 경우 새로운 관세 권한을 어떻게 또는 언제 사용할 수 있을지에 대해 아직 자세히 설명하지 않았다.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 앞으로 몇 주가 중요할 것이라고 말한다: 많은 것이 백악관이 새로운 관세 권한을 얼마나 적극적으로 행사하기로 선택할지, 그리고 러시아 석유의 주요 구매자들(아시아의 여러 대규모 경제를 포함)이 추가 압박에 어떻게 대응하는지에 달려 있을 것이다.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: 에너지 시장은 법안이 서명되면 집행 일정에 대한 신호를 면밀히 주시할 가능성이 높다.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *이 보도는 공개적으로 이용 가능한 입법 요약 및 의회 사무소의 성명에 기반한다.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: 집행 및 이행의 세부사항은 행정부가 추가 지침을 발표함에 따라 변할 수 있다.*

zh.title: 国会向特朗普提交范围广泛的俄伊制裁法案

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: 众议院已对这项针对俄罗斯和伊朗的广泛制裁方案给予最终批准,将其送交特朗普总统签署。

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 在参议院早前批准其版本后,该法案以两党支持通过了众议院,结束了数月的谈判,涉及美国应在多大程度上加强对莫斯科和德黑兰的经济压力。

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## 该法案针对的目标

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: 根据国会工作人员发布的总结,该立法重点关注三个主要领域:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **俄罗斯能源部门** — 对促进俄罗斯石油和天然气出口的公司和金融机构的新限制。

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"幽灵船队"** — 对老旧、所有权不透明的油轮网络的制裁,分析人士称俄罗斯利用这些油轮绕过现有价格上限和出口限制。

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **伊朗相关网络** — 针对被指控支持伊朗能源出口和相关金融交易的实体的额外措施。

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: 支持该法案的议员将其描述为堵住漏洞的努力,这些漏洞曾使两国尽管受到多年制裁仍能向全球市场供应大量石油。

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## 白宫的新关税工具

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: 最受关注的条款之一授予总统自由裁量权,对继续大量购买俄罗斯石油的国家商品征收高达100%的关税。

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: 支持者表示,该工具旨在向买方(而非俄罗斯直接)施压,通过提高继续购买的经济成本,促使其转向非俄罗斯原油。

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: 贸易分析人士警告说,如果广泛使用这样的关税,可能会对全球供应链和与为国内需求进口俄罗斯能源的国家的关系产生连锁反应。

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: 据报道,该法案给予白宫在何时以及针对谁适用该权限方面相当大的灵活性,而不是要求自动采取行动。

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## 国会山的反应

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: 该措施获得了政治各派议员的支持,两党支持者将其描述为对乌克兰战争和伊朗地区活动的长期迫切的回应。

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: 据报道,一些议员在议会辩论中对能源价格和依赖俄罗斯廉价原油的盟国经济可能受到的影响表示担忧,不过这些担忧不足以阻止该法案通过。

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 国会领导层表示,该法案反映了两党共识,即现有制裁在抑制流向莫斯科和德黑兰的收入方面还不够有力。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: 两院都已通过各自的版本,该法案现提交给特朗普总统,他预计将在决定是否签署成为法律之前进行审查。

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: 政府官员尚未说明如果该法案生效,新的关税权限将如何或何时被使用。

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: 分析人士表示,接下来的几周将很关键:很大程度上取决于白宫选择如何积极地行使新的关税权力,以及俄罗斯石油的主要买家(包括亚洲的数个大型经济体)如何应对这一额外压力。

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: 一旦该法案签署生效,能源市场可能会密切关注任何关于执行时间表的信号。

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *本报告基于公开发布的立法总结和国会办公室的声明。

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: 执行和实施的细节可能会随着政府发布进一步指导而不断演变。*

hi.title: कांग्रेस ट्रम्प के डेस्क को व्यापक रूस-ईरान प्रतिबंध विधेयक भेजती है

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: प्रतिनिधि सभा ने रूस और ईरान को लक्षित एक व्यापक प्रतिबंध पैकेज को अंतिम मंजूरी दे दी है, इस उपाय को राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प को हस्ताक्षर के लिए भेज रही है।

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: सीनेट ने पहले अपने संस्करण को मंजूरी दे दी के बाद विधेयक दोनों पक्षों के समर्थन से सभा को मंजूर हुआ, मास्को और तेहरान पर आर्थिक दबाव को कसने में संयुक्त राज्य को कितनी दूर जाना चाहिए इस पर महीनों की बातचीत समाप्त हुई।

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## विधेयक किसे लक्षित करता है

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: संसदीय कर्मचारियों द्वारा जारी सारांश के अनुसार, विधान तीन मुख्य क्षेत्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **रूस का ऊर्जा क्षेत्र** — रूसी तेल और गैस निर्यात को सुविधाजनक बनाने वाली कंपनियों और वित्तीय संस्थानों पर नए प्रतिबंध।

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"छाया बेड़ा"** — पुराने, अपारदर्शी रूप से स्वामित्व वाले टैंकरों के नेटवर्क पर प्रतिबंध जिसे विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि रूस मौजूदा मूल्य सीमा और निर्यात प्रतिबंधों के चारों ओर तेल ले जाने के लिए उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **ईरान से जुड़े नेटवर्क** — ईरान के ऊर्जा निर्यात और संबंधित वित्तीय लेनदेन का समर्थन करने का आरोप लगाए गए संस्थाओं को लक्षित करने वाले अतिरिक्त उपाय।

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: विधेयक का समर्थन करने वाले विधायकों ने इसे ऐसे प्रयास के रूप में वर्णित किया जो पिछले वर्षों के प्रतिबंधों के बावजूद दोनों देशों को वैश्विक बाजारों में महत्वपूर्ण मात्रा में तेल प्रवाहित करने की अनुमति देने वाली खामियों को बंद करने के लिए है।

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## व्हाइट हाउस के लिए एक नया टैरिफ उपकरण

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: सबसे अधिक देखे जाने वाले प्रावधानों में से एक राष्ट्रपति को उन देशों से वस्तुओं पर 100% तक टैरिफ लगाने का विवेकाधीन अधिकार देता है जो महत्वपूर्ण मात्रा में रूसी तेल खरीद जारी रखते हैं।

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: समर्थकों का कहना है कि यह उपकरण खरीदारों को — रूस के बजाय सीधे — रूसी कच्चे तेल से विविध करने के लिए दबाव डालने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, चल रही खरीद की आर्थिक लागत को बहुत अधिक बनाकर।

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: व्यापार विश्लेषकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि ऐसे टैरिफ, यदि व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किए जाते हैं, तो वैश्विक आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं और घरेलू जरूरतों के लिए रूसी ऊर्जा आयात करने वाले देशों के साथ संबंधों पर तरंग प्रभाव डाल सकते हैं।

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: विधेयक कथित तौर पर व्हाइट हाउस को स्वचालित कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता के बजाय कब और किसके विरुद्ध अधिकार लागू करने का निर्णय लेने में काफी लचीलापन छोड़ता है।

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## कैपिटल हिल पर प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: यह उपाय राजनीतिक स्पेक्ट्रम के विधायकों से समर्थन लाया, दोनों पक्षों में समर्थकों द्वारा इसे यूक्रेन में युद्ध और ईरान की क्षेत्रीय गतिविधियों के लिए एक लंबे समय से ऋणी प्रतिक्रिया के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: कुछ सदस्यों ने कथित तौर पर सभा में बहस के दौरान ऊर्जा कीमतों पर संभावित प्रभाव और सहयोगी अर्थव्यवस्थाओं पर चिंता जताई जो छूट प्राप्त रूसी कच्चे तेल पर निर्भर हैं, हालांकि ये चिंताएं पारित होने को अवरुद्ध करने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं थीं।

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: संसद के नेतृत्व ने संकेत दिया है कि विधेयक एक द्विपक्षीय सहमति को प्रतिबिंबित करता है कि मौजूदा प्रतिबंध मास्को और तेहरान में बहने वाली राजस्व को नियंत्रित करने में पर्याप्त दूर नहीं गए हैं।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.tr: दोनों सभाओं के अपने संस्करण पास करने के साथ, विधेयक अब राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प के पास जाता है, जिन से इसे कानून में हस्ताक्षर करने का निर्णय लेने से पहले इसकी समीक्षा करने की उम्मीद की जाती है।

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*

es.title: El Congreso Envía un Proyecto de Ley de Sanciones Integral contra Rusia e Irán al Escritorio de Trump

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: La Cámara de Representantes ha dado aprobación final a un amplio paquete de sanciones dirigido a Rusia e Irán, enviando la medida al Presidente Trump para su firma.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: El proyecto de ley fue aprobado por la cámara con apoyo de ambos partidos después de que el Senado aprobara su propia versión anteriormente, terminando meses de negociaciones sobre hasta qué punto Estados Unidos debería presionar económicamente a Moscú y Teherán.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## Qué Abarca el Proyecto de Ley

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: Según los resúmenes publicados por el personal del Congreso, la legislación se enfoca en tres áreas principales:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **El sector energético de Rusia** — nuevas restricciones sobre empresas e instituciones financieras que facilitan las exportaciones de petróleo y gas ruso.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **La "flota fantasma"** — sanciones sobre la red de petroleros antiguos de propiedad opaca que, según dicen los analistas, Rusia ha utilizado para transportar petróleo eludiendo los límites de precios y las restricciones de exportación existentes.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Redes vinculadas a Irán** — medidas adicionales dirigidas a entidades acusadas de apoyar las exportaciones de energía de Irán y transacciones financieras relacionadas.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Los legisladores que respaldaron el proyecto de ley lo describieron como un esfuerzo para cerrar las lagunas que han permitido a ambos países mantener volúmenes significativos de petróleo fluyendo hacia los mercados globales a pesar de años de sanciones anteriores.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Una Nueva Herramienta Arancelaria para la Casa Blanca

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: Una de las disposiciones más observadas otorga al presidente autoridad discrecional para imponer aranceles de hasta el 100% sobre bienes provenientes de países que continúen comprando petróleo ruso en volúmenes significativos.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Los partidarios dicen que la herramienta está diseñada para presionar a los compradores —más que a Rusia directamente— para que se diversifiquen lejos del crudo ruso, haciendo que el costo económico de las compras continuas sea mucho más alto.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Los analistas comerciales han advertido que tales aranceles, si se utilizan ampliamente, podrían tener efectos ondulantes en las cadenas de suministro global y en las relaciones con países que importan energía rusa para necesidades domésticas.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Al parecer, el proyecto de ley deja a la Casa Blanca una flexibilidad considerable al decidir cuándo y contra quién aplicar la autoridad, en lugar de requerir una acción automática.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Reacción en Capitol Hill

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: La medida atrajo apoyo de legisladores de todo el espectro político, con proponentes de ambos partidos enmarcándola como una respuesta largamente esperada a la guerra en Ucrania y a las actividades regionales de Irán.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Aparentemente, algunos miembros plantearon preocupaciones durante el debate en el plenario sobre posibles efectos en los precios de la energía y en las economías aliadas que han dependido del crudo ruso con descuento, aunque esas preocupaciones no fueron suficientes para bloquear su aprobación.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: El liderazgo del Congreso ha indicado que el proyecto de ley refleja un consenso bipartidista de que las sanciones existentes no han ido lo suficientemente lejos en reducir los ingresos que fluyen a Moscú y Teherán.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué Sucede Ahora

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Con ambas cámaras habiendo aprobado sus versiones, el proyecto de ley se dirige ahora al Presidente Trump, que se espera revise antes de decidir si lo firma para convertirlo en ley.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la administración aún no han detallado cómo o cuándo se podría utilizar la nueva autoridad arancelaria si el proyecto de ley se promulga.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Los analistas dicen que las próximas semanas serán reveladoras: mucho dependerá de qué tan agresivamente la Casa Blanca elija ejercer los nuevos poderes arancelarios, y cómo los principales compradores de petróleo ruso —incluyendo varias grandes economías en Asia— responden a la presión adicional.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Los mercados de energía probablemente observarán de cerca cualquier señal sobre cronogramas de cumplimiento una vez que se firme el proyecto de ley.

segments.tr: *Este informe se basa en resúmenes legislativos disponibles públicamente y declaraciones de oficinas del Congreso.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Los detalles de cumplimiento e implementación pueden evolucionar a medida que la administración emite más orientación.*

ar.title: يرسل الكونجرس مشروع قانون العقوبات الشاملة ضد روسيا وإيران إلى مكتب ترامب

segments.tr: منحت مجلس النواب موافقته النهائية على حزمة عقوبات واسعة موجهة ضد روسيا وإيران، مما أرسل التدبير إلى الرئيس ترامب لتوقيعه.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: مرر مشروع القانون المجلس بدعم من كلا الحزبين بعد أن وافق مجلس الشيوخ على نسخته الخاصة في وقت سابق، منهياً أشهراً من المفاوضات حول ما يجب أن تذهب إليه الولايات المتحدة في تشديد الضغط الاقتصادي على موسكو وطهران.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## ما يستهدفه مشروع القانون

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: وفقاً للملخصات الصادرة عن موظفي الكونجرس، يركز التشريع على ثلاث مجالات رئيسية:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **قطاع الطاقة الروسي** — قيود جديدة على الشركات والمؤسسات المالية التي تسهل صادرات النفط والغاز الروسية.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"الأسطول الظل"** — عقوبات على شبكة الناقلات القديمة والمملوكة بشكل غامض التي يقول المحللون إن روسيا استخدمتها لنقل النفط حول حدود الأسعار المعمول بها والقيود على الصادرات.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **الشبكات المرتبطة بإيران** — تدابير إضافية تستهدف الكيانات المتهمة بدعم صادرات الطاقة الإيرانية والمعاملات المالية ذات الصلة.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: وصف المشرعون الذين دعموا مشروع القانون بأنه جهد لإغلاق الثغرات التي سمحت لكلا الدولتين بالحفاظ على أحجام كبيرة من النفط المتدفقة إلى الأسواق العالمية رغم سنوات من العقوبات السابقة.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## أداة تعريفة جديدة للبيت الأبيض

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: تمنح إحدى الأحكام التي تحظى بأقرب مراقبة الرئيس سلطة تقديرية لفرض تعريفات تصل إلى 100٪ على السلع من الدول التي تستمر في شراء النفط الروسي بحجم كبير.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: يقول الداعمون إن الأداة مصممة لممارسة الضغط على المشترين - وليس روسيا مباشرة - للتنويع بعيداً عن الخام الروسي، من خلال جعل التكلفة الاقتصادية للمشتريات المستمرة أعلى بكثير.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: حذر محللو التجارة من أن مثل هذه التعريفات، إذا تم استخدامها على نطاق واسع، يمكن أن يكون لها تأثيرات متموجة على سلاسل الإمداد العالمية والعلاقات مع الدول التي تستورد الطاقة الروسية لاحتياجاتها المحلية.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: يترك مشروع القانون على ما يُذاع، البيت الأبيض مرونة كبيرة في تحديد متى وضد من تطبيق السلطة، بدلاً من المطالبة بإجراء تلقائي.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## رد الفعل على كابيتول هيل

segments.tr: جذب التدبير دعماً من المشرعين عبر الطيف السياسي، مع وضع الداعمين في كلا الحزبين إطاراً له باعتباره رداً متأخراً عن الاستحقاق على الحرب في أوكرانيا وعلى الأنشطة الإقليمية الإيرانية.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: أثار بعض الأعضاء على ما يُذاع مخاوف أثناء النقاش في الجلسة العامة بشأن الآثار المحتملة على أسعار الطاقة والاقتصادات المتحالفة التي تعتمد على الخام الروسي المخفض، على الرغم من أن هذه المخاوف لم تكن كافية لحظر الموافقة.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: أشار قيادة الكونجرس إلى أن مشروع القانون يعكس إجماعاً ثنائي الحزب بأن العقوبات الحالية لم تذهب بعيداً كافياً في تقييد الإيرادات المتدفقة إلى موسكو وطهران.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ما يحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.

segments.tr: La Chambre des représentants a donné son approbation finale à un large paquet de sanctions visant la Russie et l'Iran, envoyant la mesure au président Trump pour sa signature.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Le projet de loi a été adopté par la chambre avec le soutien des deux partis après que le Sénat ait approuvé sa propre version plus tôt, mettant fin à des mois de négociations sur la question de savoir jusqu'où les États-Unis devraient aller dans le renforcement de la pression économique sur Moscou et Téhéran.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## Ce que le projet de loi cible

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: Selon les résumés publiés par le personnel du Congrès, la législation se concentre sur trois domaines principaux :

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **Le secteur énergétique russe** — nouvelles restrictions sur les entreprises et institutions financières qui facilitent les exportations de pétrole et de gaz russes.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **La « flotte fantôme »** — sanctions sur le réseau de pétroliers vieillissants et opaquement possédés que les analystes disent que la Russie a utilisé pour déplacer le pétrole autour des plafonds de prix et des restrictions d'exportation existants.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Les réseaux liés à l'Iran** — des mesures supplémentaires ciblant les entités accusées de soutenir les exportations énergétiques de l'Iran et les transactions financières connexes.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Les législateurs qui ont soutenu le projet de loi l'ont décrit comme un effort pour fermer les lacunes qui ont permis aux deux pays de maintenir des volumes importants de pétrole circulant sur les marchés mondiaux malgré des années de sanctions antérieures.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Un nouvel outil tarifaire pour la Maison-Blanche

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: L'une des dispositions les plus étroitement surveillées accorde au président une autorité discrétionnaire pour imposer des tarifs allant jusqu'à 100 % sur les biens des pays qui continuent à acheter du pétrole russe en volume important.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Les partisans disent que l'outil est conçu pour faire pression sur les acheteurs — plutôt que sur la Russie directement — afin qu'ils diversifient leurs sources de pétrole brut russe, en rendant le coût économique des achats continus beaucoup plus élevé.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Les analystes du commerce ont mis en garde contre le fait que de tels tarifs, s'ils sont utilisés largement, pourraient avoir des effets d'entraînement sur les chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales et sur les relations avec les pays qui importent de l'énergie russe pour les besoins domestiques.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Le projet de loi laisse apparemment à la Maison-Blanche une flexibilité considérable pour décider quand et contre qui appliquer cette autorité, plutôt que d'exiger une action automatique.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Réaction sur la Colline du Capitole

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: La mesure a reçu le soutien de législateurs de tout l'éventail politique, avec des partisans dans les deux partis la présentant comme une réponse depuis longtemps attendue à la guerre en Ukraine et aux activités régionales de l'Iran.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Certains membres ont apparemment soulevé des inquiétudes lors du débat à l'assemblée concernant les effets potentiels sur les prix de l'énergie et les économies alliées qui ont compté sur le pétrole brut russe à prix réduit, bien que ces préoccupations n'aient pas été suffisantes pour bloquer l'adoption.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants du Congrès ont indiqué que le projet de loi reflète un consensus bipartite selon lequel les sanctions existantes n'ont pas été suffisantes pour freiner les revenus qui affluent vers Moscou et Téhéran.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Avec les deux chambres ayant adopté leurs versions, le projet de loi se dirige maintenant vers le président Trump, qui devrait l'examiner avant de décider s'il le signe pour en faire une loi.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Les responsables de l'administration n'ont pas encore détaillé comment ou quand la nouvelle autorité tarifaire pourrait être utilisée si le projet de loi est adopté.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Les analystes disent que les semaines à venir seront révélatrices : beaucoup dépendra de l'agressivité avec laquelle la Maison-Blanche choisira d'exercer les nouveaux pouvoirs tarifaires, et de la façon dont les principaux acheteurs de pétrole russe — y compris plusieurs grandes économies en Asie — réagissent à la pression supplémentaire.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Les marchés de l'énergie vont probablement surveiller de près tous les signaux concernant les délais de mise en œuvre une fois que le projet de loi sera signé.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *Ce rapport est basé sur les résumés législatifs disponibles au public et les déclarations des bureaux du Congrès.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Les détails de la mise en application et de la mise en œuvre peuvent évoluer à mesure que l'administration émet d'autres directives.*

pt.title: Congresso Encaminha Amplo Projeto de Lei de Sanções contra Rússia e Irã ao Presidente Trump

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: A Câmara dos Representantes aprovou definitivamente um amplo pacote de sanções direcionado à Rússia e ao Irã, encaminhando a medida ao Presidente Trump para sua assinatura.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: O projeto foi aprovado na câmara com apoio de ambos os partidos após o Senado ter aprovado sua própria versão anteriormente, encerrando meses de negociações sobre até que ponto os Estados Unidos deveria apertar a pressão econômica sobre Moscou e Teerã.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## O que o Projeto Visa

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: De acordo com resumos divulgados pela equipe do Congresso, a legislação se concentra em três áreas principais:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **Setor energético da Rússia** — novas restrições a empresas e instituições financeiras que facilitam as exportações de petróleo e gás russos.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **A "frota fantasma"** — sanções à rede de navios-tanque envelhecidos e de propriedade opaca que analistas dizem que a Rússia usou para movimentar petróleo contornando tetos de preço existentes e restrições de exportação.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Redes ligadas ao Irã** — medidas adicionais direcionadas a entidades acusadas de apoiar as exportações de energia do Irã e transações financeiras relacionadas.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Legisladores que apoiaram o projeto o descreveram como um esforço para fechar brechas que permitiram que ambos os países mantivessem volumes significativos de petróleo fluindo para os mercados globais apesar de anos de sanções anteriores.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Uma Nova Ferramenta de Tarifa para a Casa Branca

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: Uma das disposições mais observadas concede ao presidente autoridade discricionária para impor tarifas de até 100% em bens de países que continuarem comprando petróleo russo em volume significativo.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Os apoiadores dizem que a ferramenta foi projetada para pressionar os compradores — em vez da Rússia — a se diversificarem afastando do petróleo bruto russo, tornando o custo econômico das compras contínuas muito mais alto.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Analistas comerciais alertaram que tais tarifas, se usadas amplamente, poderiam ter efeitos em cascata nas cadeias de suprimento globais e nas relações com países que importam energia russa para necessidades domésticas.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Segundo relatos, o projeto deixa a Casa Branca com considerável flexibilidade ao decidir quando e contra quem aplicar a autoridade, em vez de exigir ação automática.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Reação no Capitólio

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: A medida recebeu apoio de legisladores de todo o espectro político, com proponentes em ambos os partidos enquadrando-a como uma resposta muito aguardada à guerra na Ucrânia e às atividades regionais do Irã.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Alguns membros levantaram preocupações durante o debate em plenário sobre possíveis efeitos nos preços de energia e em economias aliadas que dependeram de petróleo bruto russo com desconto, embora essas preocupações não fossem suficientes para bloquear a aprovação.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: A liderança do Congresso indicou que o projeto reflete um consenso bipartidário de que as sanções existentes não foram longe o suficiente em reduzir a receita fluindo para Moscou e Teerã.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece Agora

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Com ambas as câmaras tendo aprovado suas versões, o projeto agora segue para o Presidente Trump, que deverá revisá-lo antes de decidir se o assinará para convertê-lo em lei.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Funcionários da administração ainda não detalharam como ou quando a nova autoridade tarifária poderia ser usada se o projeto for promulgado.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Analistas dizem que as próximas semanas serão reveladoras: muito dependerá do quão agressivamente a Casa Branca usará os novos poderes tarifários, e como os principais compradores de petróleo russo — incluindo várias grandes economias na Ásia — responderão à pressão adicional.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Os mercados de energia provavelmente observarão atentamente qualquer sinal sobre prazos de cumprimento uma vez que o projeto for assinado.

segments.tr: *Este relatório é baseado em resumos legislativos disponíveis publicamente e declarações dos escritórios do Congresso.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Os detalhes do cumprimento e implementação podem evoluir conforme a administração emite orientação adicional.*

in.title: Kongres Mengirimkan Rancangan Undang-Undang Sanksi Rusia-Iran yang Komprehensif ke Meja Trump

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat telah memberikan persetujuan final untuk paket sanksi luas yang ditujukan pada Rusia dan Iran, mengirimkan langkah ini ke Presiden Trump untuk ditandatangani.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Rancangan undang-undang melewati sidang dengan dukungan dari kedua belah pihak setelah Senat menyetujui versinya sendiri sebelumnya, mengakhiri berbulan-bulan negosiasi tentang seberapa jauh Amerika Serikat harus mengetatkan tekanan ekonomi pada Moskow dan Teheran.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## Target Rancangan Undang-Undang Ini

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: Menurut ringkasan yang dirilis oleh staf kongres, peraturan perundang-undangan berfokus pada tiga area utama:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **Sektor energi Rusia** — pembatasan baru pada perusahaan dan institusi keuangan yang memfasilitasi ekspor minyak dan gas Rusia.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"Armada bayangan"** — sanksi terhadap jaringan kapal tanker tua dengan kepemilikan yang tidak transparan yang analis katakan telah digunakan Rusia untuk memindahkan minyak melampaui batas harga yang ada dan pembatasan ekspor.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Jaringan terkait Iran** — tindakan tambahan yang menargetkan entitas yang didakwa mendukung ekspor energi Iran dan transaksi keuangan terkait.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Pembuat undang-undang yang mendukung rancangan ini menggambarkannya sebagai upaya untuk menutup celah yang telah memungkinkan kedua negara mempertahankan volume minyak yang signifikan mengalir ke pasar global meskipun bertahun-tahun sanksi sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Alat Tarif Baru untuk Gedung Putih

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: Salah satu ketentuan yang paling diperhatikan memberikan presiden kewenangan diskresi untuk mengenakan tarif hingga 100% pada barang dari negara-negara yang terus membeli minyak Rusia dalam volume yang signifikan.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Para pendukung mengatakan alat ini dirancang untuk memberikan tekanan pada pembeli — bukan Rusia secara langsung — agar beralih dari minyak mentah Rusia, dengan membuat biaya ekonomi pembelian berkelanjutan jauh lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Analis perdagangan telah memperingatkan bahwa tarif semacam itu, jika digunakan secara luas, dapat memiliki dampak riak pada rantai pasokan global dan hubungan dengan negara-negara yang mengimpor energi Rusia untuk kebutuhan domestik.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Rancangan undang-undang dilaporkan meninggalkan Gedung Putih fleksibilitas yang cukup dalam memutuskan kapan dan terhadap siapa menerapkan kewenangan ini, bukan memerlukan tindakan otomatis.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Reaksi di Capitol Hill

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: Langkah ini menarik dukungan dari pembuat undang-undang di seluruh spektrum politik, dengan para pendukung di kedua belah pihak membingkainya sebagai respons yang telah lama tertunda terhadap perang di Ukraina dan kegiatan regional Iran.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Beberapa anggota dilaporkan mengangkat kekhawatiran selama perdebatan di lantai tentang efek potensial pada harga energi dan ekonomi sekutu yang telah bergantung pada minyak mentah Rusia yang didiskon, meskipun kekhawatiran itu tidak cukup untuk memblokir kelulusan.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Kepemimpinan kongres telah menunjukkan bahwa rancangan undang-undang mencerminkan konsensus bipartisan bahwa sanksi yang ada belum cukup jauh dalam membatasi pendapatan yang mengalir ke Moskow dan Teheran.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Dengan kedua kamar telah menyetujui versi mereka, rancangan undang-undang sekarang dikirimkan ke Presiden Trump, yang diharapkan meninjau sebelum memutuskan apakah akan menandatanganinya menjadi undang-undang.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Pejabat administrasi belum merinci bagaimana atau kapan kewenangan tarif baru dapat digunakan jika rancangan undang-undang disahkan.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Analis mengatakan minggu-minggu mendatang akan sangat menceritakan: banyak tergantung pada seberapa agresif Gedung Putih memilih untuk menggunakan kekuatan tarif baru, dan bagaimana pembeli utama minyak Rusia — termasuk beberapa ekonomi besar di Asia — merespons tekanan tambahan.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Pasar energi cenderung memantau dengan cermat setiap sinyal tentang lini waktu penegakan setelah rancangan undang-undang ditandatangani.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *Laporan ini didasarkan pada ringkasan peraturan perundang-undangan yang tersedia untuk umum dan pernyataan dari kantor-kantor kongres.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Detail penegakan dan implementasi dapat berkembang seiring administrasi mengeluarkan panduan lebih lanjut.*

ja.title: 議会がロシア・イラン包括制裁法案をトランプに送付

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: 下院はロシアとイランを対象とした広範な制裁パッケージに最終承認を与え、この法案をトランプ大統領の署名のために送付した。

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 法案は上院が先に独自の版を承認した後、両党の支持により議院を通過し、米国がモスクワとテヘランへの経済的圧力をどこまで強化すべきかについての数ヶ月間の交渉を終わらせた。

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## 法案が対象とするもの

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: 議会スタッフが発表した要約によると、この法案は3つの主な領域に焦点を当てています:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **ロシアのエネルギー部門** — ロシアの石油・ガス輸出を促進する企業および金融機関への新しい制限。

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **「シャドーフリート」** — アナリストがロシアが既存の価格キャップと輸出制限を回避して石油を移動するために使用しているとされる、老朽化した不透明に所有されたタンカーのネットワークに対する制裁。

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **イラン関連ネットワーク** — イランのエネルギー輸出と関連する金融取引の支援で非難されている団体を対象とした追加措置。

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: 法案を支持した議員らは、それを何年にもわたる制裁にもかかわらず、両国が世界市場への石油の相当な量の流れを継続することを可能にした抜け穴を閉じるための取り組みとして説明した。

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## ホワイトハウスの新しい関税ツール

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: 最も注視されている規定の1つは、ロシア産石油を大量に購入し続ける国からの商品に対して最大100%の関税を課す裁量権を大統領に与えている。

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: 支持者は、このツールはロシアに直接ではなく購入者に圧力をかけることによって、継続的な購入の経済的コストをはるかに高くすることで、ロシア産原油から多様化させるよう設計されていると述べている。

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: 貿易アナリストは、このような関税が広く使用された場合、世界的なサプライチェーンと国内ニーズのためにロシアエネルギーを輸入している国との関係に波及効果を及ぼす可能性があると警告している。

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: 法案は、自動的な行動を要求するのではなく、いつ誰に対して権限を適用するかを決定する際に、ホワイトハウスに相当な柔軟性を与えるとされている。

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## キャピトルヒルでの反応

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: この法案は、政治的スペクトラム全体の議員からの支持を得ており、両党の支持者はウクライナ戦争とイランの地域活動への遅すぎた対応としてそれを位置づけている。

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: 一部の議員は、エネルギー価格と割引ロシア産原油に依存していた同盟国経済への潜在的な影響について、本会議上で懸念を提起したとされているが、それらの懸念は可決を阻止するのに十分ではなかった。

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: 議会指導部は、この法案が既存の制裁がモスクワとテヘランへの収益流入を十分に抑制していないという超党派的なコンセンサスを反映していることを示唆している。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次は何が起こるか

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: 両院がそれぞれの版を可決したので、法案はトランプ大統領に向かい、彼は法律に署名するかどうかを決定する前にそれを確認することが期待されている。

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: 政権当局者はまだ、法案が可決された場合、新しい関税権がどのように、またはいつ使用されるかを詳述していない。

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: アナリストは、今後数週間が決定的だと述べている：多くは、ホワイトハウスがどの程度積極的に新しい関税権を行使することを選択するか、およびロシア産石油の主要な買い手—アジアの複数の大規模経済を含む—が追加された圧力にどのように対応するかに依存している。

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: エネルギー市場は、法案に署名された後、執行スケジュールのシグナルを注視する可能性が高い。

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *このレポートは、公開されている立法要約および議会事務所からの声明に基づいています。

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: 執行と実装の詳細は、政権がさらなるガイダンスを発行するにつれて進化する可能性がある。*

de.title: Kongress schickt umfassendes Sanktionsgesetz gegen Russland und Iran an Trumps Schreibtisch

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: Das Repräsentantenhaus hat die abschließende Genehmigung für ein umfassendes Sanktionspaket gegen Russland und Iran erteilt und leitet die Maßnahme zur Unterzeichnung an Präsident Trump weiter.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Das Gesetz wurde mit Unterstützung beider Parteien verabschiedet, nachdem der Senat seine eigene Version zuvor genehmigt hatte, womit Monate der Verhandlungen darüber beendet wurden, wie weit die Vereinigten Staaten in ihrer wirtschaftlichen Druckausübung auf Moskau und Teheran gehen sollten.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## Ziele des Gesetzes

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: Nach Zusammenfassungen des Kongressstabs konzentriert sich die Gesetzgebung auf drei Hauptbereiche:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **Russlands Energiesektor** — neue Beschränkungen für Unternehmen und Finanzinstitute, die russische Öl- und Gasexporte ermöglichen.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **Die „Schattenflotte"** — Sanktionen gegen das Netzwerk von alternden, unklar verwalteten Tankern, die Analysten zufolge Russland verwendet hat, um Öl unter Umgehung bestehender Preisdeckel und Exportbeschränkungen zu transportieren.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Mit dem Iran verbundene Netzwerke** — zusätzliche Maßnahmen gegen Entitäten, denen die Unterstützung von Irans Energieexporten und damit verbundenen Finanztransaktionen vorgeworfen wird.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Abgeordnete, die das Gesetz unterstützten, beschrieben es als Bemühung, Lücken zu schließen, die es beiden Ländern ermöglicht haben, große Ölmengen auf den Weltmarkt zu bringen, trotz Jahren früherer Sanktionen.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Ein neues Zollinstrument für das Weiße Haus

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: Eine der am genauesten beobachteten Bestimmungen gewährt dem Präsidenten diskretionäre Befugnis, Zölle von bis zu 100 % auf Waren aus Ländern zu verhängen, die weiterhin in erheblichen Mengen russisches Öl kaufen.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Befürworter sagen, dass das Instrument darauf ausgelegt ist, Käufer — statt Russland direkt — zum Ausweichen von russischem Rohöl zu bewegen, indem die wirtschaftlichen Kosten für fortgesetzte Einkäufe erheblich erhöht werden.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Handelsanalytiker haben gewarnt, dass solche Zölle bei breiter Anwendung Auswirkungen auf globale Lieferketten und auf Beziehungen zu Ländern haben könnten, die russische Energie für den Inlandsbedarf importieren.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Das Gesetz lässt dem Weißen Haus Berichten zufolge erhebliche Flexibilität darin, wann und gegen wen die Befugnis angewendet werden soll, statt eine automatische Aktion zu erfordern.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Reaktionen im Kongress

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: Die Maßnahme erhielt Unterstützung von Abgeordneten aus dem gesamten politischen Spektrum, wobei Befürworter in beiden Parteien sie als lang überfällige Reaktion auf den Krieg in der Ukraine und die regionalen Aktivitäten des Iran darstellten.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Einige Mitglieder äußerten Berichten zufolge während der Plenumsdebatte Bedenken hinsichtlich möglicher Auswirkungen auf Energiepreise und auf befreundete Volkswirtschaften, die sich auf verbilligtes russisches Rohöl gestützt haben, obwohl diese Bedenken nicht ausreichten, um die Verabschiedung zu blockieren.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Die Kongressleitung hat angedeutet, dass das Gesetz einen überparteilichen Konsens widerspiegelt, dass die bestehenden Sanktionen nicht weit genug gingen, um die nach Moskau und Teheran fließenden Einnahmen zu drosseln.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was kommt als Nächstes

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Nachdem beide Kammern ihre Versionen verabschiedet haben, geht das Gesetz nun an Präsident Trump, der es überprüfen soll, bevor er entscheidet, ob er es unterzeichnet.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Beamte der Verwaltung haben noch nicht detailliert erläutert, wie oder wann die neue Zollbefugnis angewendet werden könnte, falls das Gesetz in Kraft tritt.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Analysten sagen, dass die kommenden Wochen aufschlussreich sein werden: Viel wird davon abhängen, wie aggressiv das Weiße Haus die neuen Zollbefugnisse einsetzt, und wie große Käufer von russischem Öl — einschließlich mehrerer großer asiatischer Volkswirtschaften — auf den zusätzlichen Druck reagieren.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Energiemärkte werden wahrscheinlich genau auf Signale zu Durchsetzungszeiträumen achten, sobald das Gesetz unterzeichnet ist.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *Dieser Bericht basiert auf öffentlich zugänglichen Gesetzgebungszusammenfassungen und Stellungnahmen aus Kongressbüros.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Details zur Durchsetzung und Umsetzung können sich ändern, wenn die Verwaltung weitere Richtlinien herausgibt.*

vi.title: Quốc Hội Gửi Dự Luật Trừng Phạt Nga-Iran Toàn Diện tới Bàn Làm Việc của Trump

segments.src: The House of Representatives has given final approval to a broad sanctions package aimed at Russia and Iran, sending the measure to President Trump for his signature.
segments.tr: Hạ viện Hoa Kỳ đã phê duyệt cuối cùng một gói trừng phạt toàn diện nhằm vào Nga và Iran, gửi biện pháp này tới Tổng thống Trump để ký.

segments.src: The bill cleared the chamber with support from both parties after the Senate approved its own version earlier, ending months of negotiations over how far the United States should go in tightening economic pressure on Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Dự luật đã được thông qua Hạ viện với sự ủng hộ từ cả hai đảng sau khi Thượng viện phê duyệt phiên bản của mình trước đó, kết thúc những tháng đàm phán về việc Hoa Kỳ nên đi xa đến mức nào trong việc siết chặt áp lực kinh tế lên Moscow và Tehran.

segments.src: ## What the Bill Targets
segments.tr: ## Dự Luật Nhắm Vào Những Gì

segments.src: According to summaries released by congressional staff, the legislation focuses on three main areas:
segments.tr: Theo các bản tóm tắt được phát hành bởi nhân viên Quốc hội, dự luật này tập trung vào ba lĩnh vực chính:

segments.src: - **Russia's energy sector** — new restrictions on companies and financial institutions that facilitate Russian oil and gas exports.
segments.tr: - **Lĩnh vực năng lượng của Nga** — các hạn chế mới đối với các công ty và tổ chức tài chính hỗ trợ xuất khẩu dầu khí Nga.

segments.src: - **The "shadow fleet"** — sanctions on the network of aging, opaquely owned tankers that analysts say Russia has used to move oil around existing price caps and export restrictions.
segments.tr: - **"Lực lượng bóng"** — trừng phạt mạng lưới các tàu chở dầu lâu năm, sở hữu mờ ám mà các nhà phân tích cho rằng Nga đã sử dụng để di chuyển dầu mỏ xung quanh các giá trần hiện có và hạn chế xuất khẩu.

segments.src: - **Iran-linked networks** — additional measures targeting entities accused of supporting Iran's energy exports and related financial transactions.
segments.tr: - **Các mạng liên kết với Iran** — các biện pháp bổ sung nhắm vào các thực thể bị cáo buộc hỗ trợ xuất khẩu năng lượng của Iran và các giao dịch tài chính liên quan.

segments.src: Lawmakers who backed the bill described it as an effort to close loopholes that have allowed both countries to keep significant volumes of oil flowing onto global markets despite years of earlier sanctions.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp ủng hộ dự luật mô tả nó như một nỗ lực để đóng những kẽ hở đã cho phép cả hai quốc gia giữ cho lượng lớn dầu mỏ chảy vào thị trường toàn cầu mặc dù nhiều năm trừng phạt trước đó.

segments.src: ## A New Tariff Tool for the White House
segments.tr: ## Một Công Cụ Thuế Quan Mới cho Nhà Trắng

segments.src: One of the most closely watched provisions grants the president discretionary authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue purchasing Russian oil in significant volume.
segments.tr: Một trong những điều khoản được theo dõi chặt chẽ nhất cấp cho Tổng thống quyền lực tùy ý để áp đặt thuế quan lên tới 100% đối với hàng hoá từ các quốc gia tiếp tục mua dầu Nga với khối lượng đáng kể.

segments.src: Supporters say the tool is designed to pressure buyers — rather than Russia directly — into diversifying away from Russian crude, by making the economic cost of continued purchases much higher.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ nói rằng công cụ này được thiết kế để tạo áp lực lên các nhà mua hàng — thay vì trực tiếp Nga — để đa dạng hoá tránh xa dầu thô Nga, bằng cách làm cho chi phí kinh tế của những lần mua tiếp tục cao hơn nhiều.

segments.src: Trade analysts have cautioned that such tariffs, if used broadly, could have ripple effects on global supply chains and on relations with countries that import Russian energy for domestic needs.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích thương mại cảnh báo rằng những thuế quan như vậy, nếu sử dụng rộng rãi, có thể có tác động lan toả lên các chuỗi cung ứng toàn cầu và quan hệ với các quốc gia nhập khẩu năng lượng Nga cho nhu cầu nội địa.

segments.src: The bill reportedly leaves the White House considerable flexibility in deciding when and against whom to apply the authority, rather than requiring automatic action.
segments.tr: Dự luật được cho là để lại cho Nhà Trắng sự linh hoạt đáng kể trong việc quyết định khi nào và chống lại ai để áp dụng quyền lực này, thay vì yêu cầu hành động tự động.

segments.src: ## Reaction on Capitol Hill
segments.tr: ## Phản Ứng trên Đồi Capitol

segments.src: The measure drew support from lawmakers across the political spectrum, with proponents in both parties framing it as a long-overdue response to the war in Ukraine and to Iran's regional activities.
segments.tr: Biện pháp này thu hút sự ủng hộ từ các nhà lập pháp trên toàn bộ phổ chính trị, với những người ủng hộ trong cả hai đảng xây dựng nó như một phản ứng quá muộn đối với cuộc chiến ở Ukraine và các hoạt động khu vực của Iran.

segments.src: Some members reportedly raised concerns during floor debate about potential effects on energy prices and on allied economies that have relied on discounted Russian crude, though those concerns were not enough to block passage.
segments.tr: Một số thành viên được cho là đã nêu ra những lo ngại trong cuộc tranh luận sàn về các tác động tiềm năng lên giá năng lượng và trên nền kinh tế liên minh đã dựa vào dầu thô Nga giảm giá, mặc dù những lo ngại đó không đủ để chặn thông qua.

segments.src: Congressional leadership has indicated the bill reflects a bipartisan consensus that existing sanctions have not gone far enough in curbing revenue flowing to Moscow and Tehran.
segments.tr: Lãnh đạo Quốc hội đã chỉ ra rằng dự luật phản ánh sự đồng thuận hai đảng rằng các lệnh trừng phạt hiện tại chưa đi đủ xa trong việc kiềm chế doanh thu chảy vào Moscow và Tehran.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: With both chambers having passed their versions, the bill now heads to President Trump, who is expected to review it before deciding whether to sign it into law.
segments.tr: Khi cả hai viện đã thông qua các phiên bản của họ, dự luật bây giờ được gửi tới Tổng thống Trump, người được dự kiến sẽ xem xét nó trước khi quyết định có ký thành luật hay không.

segments.src: Administration officials have not yet detailed how or when the new tariff authority might be used if the bill is enacted.
segments.tr: Các chính thức hành chính chưa chi tiết về cách thức hoặc thời điểm quyền lực thuế quan mới có thể được sử dụng nếu dự luật được ban hành.

segments.src: Analysts say the coming weeks will be telling: much will depend on how aggressively the White House chooses to wield the new tariff powers, and how major buyers of Russian oil — including several large economies in Asia — respond to the added pressure.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích nói rằng những tuần tới sẽ là bài học: nhiều điều sẽ phụ thuộc vào việc Nhà Trắng chọn sử dụng quyền lực thuế quan mới một cách tích cực như thế nào, và các nhà mua chính dầu Nga — bao gồm một số nền kinh tế lớn ở châu Á — phản ứng với áp lực bổ sung như thế nào.

segments.src: Energy markets are likely to watch closely for any signals on enforcement timelines once the bill is signed.
segments.tr: Các thị trường năng lượng có khả năng sẽ theo dõi chặt chẽ bất kỳ tín hiệu nào về các mốc thời gian thực thi sau khi dự luật được ký.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available legislative summaries and statements from congressional offices.
segments.tr: *Báo cáo này dựa trên các bản tóm tắt lập pháp công khai và các tuyên bố từ các văn phòng Quốc hội.

segments.src: Details of enforcement and implementation may evolve as the administration issues further guidance.*
segments.tr: Chi tiết về thực thi và triển khai có thể phát triển khi chính quyền đưa ra hướng dẫn tiếp theo.*
